children: Sphere 3D announced two asset sales to streamline operations and strengthen liquidity. The company sold its Iowa mining site to Simple Mining for $1.5 million, receiving $300,000 in cash and an interest-free $1.2 million note payable in equal monthly installments from Dec. 1, 2026 through Nov. 1, 2027. Sphere 3D also expects the return of a roughly $300,000 utility prepayment and a $225,000 security deposit, and concurrently ended its Iowa sublease with Simple Mining. Separately, Sphere 3D entered a binding term sheet to sell about 5,500 legacy mining machines to RepairBit for approximately $3.1 million over a 90-day delivery schedule, retaining title until payment.
